title: Fruit Into Baskets
statement: You have two baskets, and each basket holds only one type of fruit. `fruits[i]` is the type of fruit on tree i in a row. Pick one contiguous stretch of trees, putting each fruit into a basket of its type. Return the maximum number of fruits you can pick.
hints: The stretch may contain at most two distinct values.
A sliding window with a frequency map enforces that limit.
Shrink from the left while the map holds three types.

approaches.name: All subarrays
approaches.explanation: Track the set size of every slice.

approaches.name: At most two types
approaches.explanation: The map never holds more than three keys.

editorial: This is longest subarray with at most two distinct values. Expand the window, and while a third type appears, decrement the left fruit and delete it from the map when its count hits zero. The longest window is the answer.

examples.explanation: The whole row uses two types.
